caption: Temple of Apollo, Delphi
composition: Partial Doric colonnade of the Temple of Apollo under the Phaedriades · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Sacred Way below the temple, a partial run of re-erected Doric columns stands on the terrace, without a roof. The Phaedriades cliffs rise behind the ruin and the valley drops away beside it. The sky is clear, about 12.3°C. The archaeological site is closed and no floodlight schedule was found, so the columns are in moonlight only.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Temple of Apollo at Delphi in moonlight, without floodlights
